original.target_description: rs1447295 allele A association with prostate cancer; Sweden; Table 1 allele-specific odds ratio, two-sided association P value. Adjusted for covariate representing two centers.

replication.target_description: Okobia et al. (2011), Table I: overall prostate cancer in Afro-Caribbean Tobago men; rs1447295 A-carriers (C/A + A/A) versus C/C, logistic regression. The replication sample is Tobago, distinct from each original population.

n.sample_role: Successfully genotyped prostate cancer cases and controls included in the overall rs1447295 genotype analysis.
n.exclusions: Excluded prior prostate cancer at enrollment; elevated PSA/abnormal DRE without biopsy or with normal biopsy; limited to men reporting three or four African-descent grandparents. SNP-specific genotyping completeness determines included counts.
n.location: Results, Association of Chromosome 8q24 SNP rs1447295 (Region 1); Table I rs1447295 column headers
n.quote: The genotyping assays for chromosome 8q24 SNP rs1447295 were successful in 354 cases and 438 controls.

reported_success.quote: Allele A of rs1447295 was not associated with risk of prostate cancer in Tobago men.

notes:
Original target: Sweden. Original DOI 10.1038/ng1808 could not be acquired as full text; closed publisher preview, no Unpaywall/OpenAlex OA copy, repository routes unavailable or metadata-only. No original statistic was substituted from secondary reporting. Replication Table I prints genotype-carrier OR, not a per-allele OR; the supplied allele-A description does not specify an inheritance model, so the overall A-carrier comparison is used and explicitly identified. All four assigned records point to this same replication Table I contrast; this is one replication sample, not four independent samples. The replication authors' SNP-specific narrative verdict is used rather than their paper-wide conclusion about other 8q24 variants.
Source follow-up: Published article copy from private Google Drive archive; Requested DOI,title and fullauthorlist match primary NatureGenetics letter andCrossref. Sevencompletepages652–658. MethodsPDF6; complete numberedreferences onPDF7 withoutaReferencesheading caused automaticflag. Mainarticleends658; no supplement substituted. Rendered Table 1 and methods inspected. No sum or metric conversion performed; N retains printed cases/controls pair. Adjusted for covariate representing two centers.
